name: Python Imports in Strings Test
input:
test = """
		from test import test
		import TEST as T
		#LOL
		import t as t
		from Tt import T"""
		import test as test
		from test import test
		import test
		test = """
		import {
			test,
			TEST,
			Tt
		} from test"""
		# test
		import test
		import T
expected:
test = """
		from test import test
		import TEST as T
		#LOL
		import t as t
		from Tt import T"""
		import test as test
		from test import test
		import test
		test = """
		import {
			test,
			TEST,
			Tt
		} from test"""
		import T
		# test
		import test
note: Keep the three imports that bind test in source order; the original expected result changed the final binding.
